body:
Reported Player(s): SpicyTunaRoll9
Rules Broken: Continues arguing after conversation and thread was archived on the Avicus forums.
Goes as far as to private message me on another server (Overcast Network)

Evidence: http://imgur.com/Xv7U8il - this is him contacting me on another server to continue arguing with me after the thread was archived on the Avicus forums.

The thread was on OPTOBAT's thread called "Denied because of excessive infractions" or something similar.
Hopefully a member of staff could access it. 

Thanks for your help.
